description: Generate random UK Powerball lines. Each line has 5 main numbers from 1 to 69 (unique, sorted low to high) plus one Powerball from 1 to 26, drawn with cryptographic randomness. A line costs £4; UK draws are in the early hours of Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday; the jackpot odds are 1 in 292,201,338. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/powerball-generator/
